title: tool-agent case
description: One customer conversation for a tool-using agent, with the outcome the business expects (final state of the systems the agent acts on) and, optionally, the tool calls that must happen.

goal.description: for the user simulator: what the simulated customer wants

tags.description: slices: intent (refund, address, status), policy edge (over-limit, shipped), risk

critical.description: policy edges that must never fail, on any repeat

final_state.description: subset of the state after the conversation, e.g. {refunds: 0, escalated: true}

tool_sequence.description: tools that must be called in this order (other calls may be in between)
